title: Climbable
description: Defines the climbable properties of this block.
$comment: Requires format_version beta and the Upcoming Creator Features experiment (26.70.24).

can_climb.description: Whether an entity can climb this block when its feet are sharing the same position as the block.

can_hold_position_while_sneaking.description: Whether the player can stop descending and hold their position when sneaking. Defaults to false.
